title: How Foxtrot Aviation Services streamlined RFP modeling and planning with INPUT SOFT RMS

photo.alt: Ground handling agent checking tasks on a tablet next to an aircraft

profile.industry: Aviation ground services (fleet & facility appearance, line service support, janitorial)
profile.clientSince: January 2025 (using our “Calculations on Demand” service based on INPUT SOFT RMS)

overview: Since 2010, FoxTrot Aviation has delivered critical support across the U.S. for commercial and private aviation partners.
They specialize in high-stakes fleet and facility services, including on-airport janitorial and line support, ensuring consistent operational execution for airlines and MRO facilities nationwide.

paragraphs: With a rapidly expanding footprint across 32 locations, Foxtrot’s operations team faced increasing complexity during RFP cycles — balancing cost precision, staffing needs, and GSE planning across diverse airports.

list.text: Heavy reliance on spreadsheets and manual formulas
Manual and time-consuming RFP modeling prone to errors
Limited visibility into true resource utilization
Inconsistent labor and equipment planning across regions
Friction between finance and operations during proposal preparation

paragraphs: In January 2025, Foxtrot Aviation adopted INPUT SOFT Calculations On Demand service to bring automation, accuracy, and speed to their planning and bidding processes.
solutionBlock.listTitle: With this service tool, FoxTrot was able to:

list.text: Reduce RFP modeling time from days to just a few hours
Standardize cost structures and pricing methodology across all regions
Visualize labor and GSE utilization through clear, easy-to-read reports
Simulate multiple planning scenarios (“what-if” simulations) in record time
Empower true data driven decision-making for both finance and operations teams

results.heading: Key results
results.note: Beyond time savings, INPUT SOFT RMS helped Foxtrot’s leadership team gain greater confidence in cost accuracy and competitiveness, directly contributing to a higher shortlisting rate in recent bids.

wins.text: Saved 60% of the time usually spent on RFPs
Higher accuracy and more certainty in every bid
Scalable planning framework for national growth

paragraphs: Calculations On Demand transformed how we approach RFPs. What used to take days of manual calculation and coordination now takes hours, and we’re more confident in the accuracy of our numbers.
INPUT SOFT RMS tool has become a core part of our bid strategy as we expand nationally.
